channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: AI chiefs face the UN Security Council: Altman and Amodei plead for global AI standards
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Rivals in the lab, allies at the UN: OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei stood before the Security Council on Wednesday and asked governments to set common rules for AI. The White House pushed back on any new global authority.

item.title: Sanders and Casar unveil a bill to ban superintelligent AI: up to 20 years in prison and a new Department of AI
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act on September 23, 2026: a permanent ban on superintelligent AI, a temporary pause on advanced AI development, and a new cabinet-level Department of Artificial Intelligence with criminal penalties of up to 20 years.

item.title: Claude's first biology discovery: an AI lab finds a CRISPR-like enzyme system hiding in viral DNA
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Anthropic says roughly 950 Claude agents swept DNA databases for 21 hours and spotted a previously unknown enzyme system in bacteriophage DNA, with CRISPR-like features. Humans did the lab work; the AI did the noticing.

item.title: The best AI SEO tools in 2026, compared: Surfer, Clearscope, Frase, MarketMuse, and Semrush
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Google's AI Overviews and ChatGPT changed what ranking means. We compared Surfer, Clearscope, Frase, MarketMuse, and Semrush on content optimization, AI-answer tracking, and price.

item.title: Grok 4.7: SpaceXAI’s new flagship model bets on long-horizon coding work — at half the price
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SpaceXAI has released Grok 4.7, a new flagship model for coding and knowledge work built on a larger base model and a longer reinforcement-learning run — priced like its predecessor at $2 per million input tokens, roughly half what comparable frontier models charge.

item.title: Verda raises $189M at a $1B+ valuation to build Europe's own AI cloud
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: The Helsinki neocloud closed an oversubscribed $189M Series B led by Emergence Capital, topping a $1 billion valuation as it expands green-powered GPU capacity across Europe.

item.title: Bell and Cohere put sovereign AI to work inside a security operations centre
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Bell Cyber has deployed a Cohere-built cybersecurity model into its Autonomous Security Operations Centre — running entirely on Canadian infrastructure. It is the first customer-facing product of the Bell–Cohere partnership.

item.title: British Columbia sues OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge school shooting
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: British Columbia is suing OpenAI and Sam Altman personally, arguing the Tumbler Ridge school shooting could have been prevented if the company had warned police after its safety team flagged the shooter's ChatGPT account.

item.title: DeSantis predicts the AI boom will crash — and draws a hard line against taxpayer bailouts
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Speaking in Alabama, Florida's governor said the rush of money into AI and hyperscale data centers is a bubble that will eventually burst — and warned that labs cozying up to Washington could end up 'too big to fail.' It opens a new front in the fight over who gets to regulate AI.

item.title: New York opens registration for major AI developers under the RAISE Act — the first state-level frontier-AI oversight regime
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Starting in November, New York will direct large frontier AI developers to register with the state and prepare for compliance with the RAISE Act; from January 2027, published safety frameworks, 72-hour incident reporting, and quarterly catastrophic-risk assessments become mandatory. It is the first state-level oversight regime for frontier AI in the US.

item.title: Anthropic says Claude now leads 26% of its own R&D — the first public scorecard for AI building AI
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Claude went from roughly 1% of Anthropic's model R&D to a quarter in a matter of months. Anthropic is publishing its internal scorecard — and asking every rival lab to do the same.

item.title: Nscale's IPO filing: $103B in contracts, $140M in revenue — Wall Street's next test of the AI trade
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: The London neocloud filed to list on the NYSE as NSCL with $140M in first-half revenue, a $1.02B loss, and two customers — Microsoft and Anthropic — standing behind roughly 85% of its $103B contract book.

item.title: Snorkel AI triples to $3.5B on a $350M raise: the data factory behind frontier AI is the new boom market
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Snorkel AI raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation, co-led by Insight Partners and S32, as frontier labs' hunger for expert-grade training data turns the AI data layer into one of the industry's fastest-growing markets.

item.title: Xiaomi open-sources MiMo-V2.6: a trillion-parameter model takes the top of the open-weights leaderboard
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: MiMo-V2.6-Pro scored 46 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index — the highest open-weights result on record — and the weights are ungated and MIT-licensed on Hugging Face. But the livestreamed RL training run underneath may matter more than the score.

item.title: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5: flagship coding at 40% lower cost — and a slower frontier
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22: 20% lower token prices, benchmark leads on coding evals, and roughly 85% less containment-breach success in internal tests. The numbers are all vendor-reported — here is what they show and where they wobble.

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna: half the price, same pitch — intelligence is getting cheaper, not smarter
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI's new GPT-6 Sol and Luna models halve API prices versus the GPT-5.6 series — but independent analysis shows only modest capability gains and some regressions in long-form knowledge work. The story is cost efficiency, not a capability jump.…

item.title: Amazon locks Meta's Muse agent out of its storefront
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Amazon began blocking Meta's personal AI agent from shopping on Amazon.com on Sunday night, citing undisclosed access, hidden identity, and stored credentials. The move turns the agentic-commerce fight from courtroom theory into platform policy.

item.title: AI leaders call for slowing the frontier; Wall Street answers with a selloff
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Dario Amodei’s call to deliberately pace frontier AI won rare public backing from Sam Altman and Elon Musk — and rattled markets on Monday, with Nvidia, SoftBank and AI-adjacent stocks sliding worldwide.

item.title: Alibaba plans a 5–10 trillion-parameter AI model, unveils the Zhenwu V900 chip
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu used the Apsara Conference in Hangzhou to lay out a three-part bet on AI self-reliance: a 5–10 trillion-parameter model, a new T-Head chip he called China’s most powerful, and 20 gigawatts of data-center capacity by 2032 — two days before Trump and Xi meet with AI on the agenda.

item.title: Gates Foundation Launches 60-Partner Coalition to Close AI's Language Gap
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Sixty organizations — including Anthropic, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and the OpenAI Foundation — have joined the Gates Foundation's five-year push to make AI usable in underrepresented languages, aiming to reach more than 3 billion people.

item.title: OpenAI says one of its models solved 100+ open math problems; forms independent advisory group at Princeton
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: OpenAI claims an internal model trained since late August has resolved more than 100 long-standing open problems in mathematics, including the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize problem. A new nine-mathematician advisory group at the Institute for Advanced Study gets a voice in how the results reach the world — but no vote on how fast the research moves.

item.title: Arcee AI hits a $1B+ valuation on its Series B, betting frontier open-weight AI can be trained for millions, not billions
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Arcee AI's Series B values the open-weight lab at more than $1 billion. The bet: frontier models trained for tens of millions rather than billions, with U.S. national labs as strategic customers.

item.title: Anthropic taps Accenture's Faculty as its first embedded safety evaluator — $1B each over five years
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic has named Accenture’s Faculty as the first evaluator team to be embedded inside its labs, with each side pledging at least $1 billion over five years. The experiment tests whether AI safety evaluation can survive being paid for by the company it grades.

item.title: UN science panel warns Hugging Face hack is an early warning for losing control of AI
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: The UN’s scientific panel on AI has published its first thematic brief, using this summer’s OpenAI–Hugging Face incident to argue that governments should act on agent safety now — before the odds of losing control are fully understood.

item.title: Plugin4Shell: the shared flaw that left four AI coding agents open to zero-click hijack
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Air Security researchers found the same SHA-pinning flaw in Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Google's Gemini CLI — letting an attacker swap a reviewed plugin for malicious code while the agent reported everything was fine. Anthropic and OpenAI have patched; Microsoft and Google have not.
